messages:
Anya (AE): Hi team — running a POC with Helix Health. They asked for a concise "assurance manifest" for the trial: SOC 2 excerpts, ISO 27001 cert snapshot, pen-test letter, and a short control mapping to ePHI controls. Also want clarity on Dedicated vs Hosted pricing impact for an isolated POC. Can we assemble what we can share by EOD tomorrow?
Lucas (SE): We can provide SOC 2 report excerpt + summary of controls we rely on (auth, encryption, logging). For Dedicated pricing, pinging @Marco but rough bump is reserved nodes + setup — will quantify.
Marco (Security): I can draft the pen-test attestation/letter. Need to confirm scope: Helix wants proof that a 3rd-party pentest was completed in last 12 months and an attestation we permit customer-procured scans in a staging window. Does Helix require red-team scope or just external network/app tests?
Anya (AE): They asked for external + authenticated app test results ideally. They also asked for a statement that production keys are not shared and that staging uses ephemeral keys.
Marco (Security): OK. I can produce: (1) signed pen-test attestation template, (2) short note about KMS segregation + ephemeral creds for staging, (3) control mapping CSV linking our controls to HIPAA ePHI categories. I need an approval from legal for the signer on the attestation. @Emily can you confirm signer?
Emily (Legal): I can sign the attestation as Head of Legal for standard attestation language. If Helix requests any modifications to the attestation wording we should route redlines through Legal; avoid committing to operational changes. ETA for review: same day if small changes, up to 48h for bigger redlines.
Anya (AE): Thanks. Helix prefers a single ZIP with the artifacts and a short readme. Also asked whether we can provide a network diagram showing tenancy and data flow for the POC (no customer data in prod).
Jake (SRE): I can export a sanitized network diagram and a hosting manifest. We'll remove IP-level details and include CIDR/region/policy summary. For pre-signed upload, recommend 7-day expiry. Example presign snippet I use: ```aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/helix-poc.zip --expires-in 604800```
Lucas (SE): For pricing: Dedicated minimal 4-week reserved slot for POC + onboarding fee. Hosted option — no reserved cost but cost-per-token may be higher under heavy load. I can draft a short comparison table to include in the ZIP.
Marco (Security): On staging scans: we permit authenticated scans on a scheduled 3-hour window; we require pre-notice 48h and a point of contact. We'll include the scan window policy and a contact alias.
Opsbot: Ticket #IN-8243 created: "Helix Health POC assurance packet" assigned to Marco, Lucas, Jake. Due: 2026-01-14.
Anya (AE): Great. Action items: Marco -> pen-test attestation draft + scan policy text; Emily -> signer confirmation; Jake -> sanitized network diagram + manifest; Lucas -> pricing comparison; I'll collect contact info & NDA status and pack into ZIP. Can we aim for a single deliverable by 16:00 PT tomorrow?
Marco (Security): I’ll post pen-test attestation draft by 10:30 PT tomorrow and include a short explanation of what we can and cannot disclose.
Emily (Legal): I'll pre-approve the standard signer text now; if Helix requests contract-level changes we'll escalate.
Jake (SRE): Diagram + manifest will be in the ticket by 13:00 PT tomorrow.
Lucas (SE): Pricing table + one-slide summary by 15:00 PT tomorrow.
Anya (AE): Awesome — I’ll follow up with Helix and request the NDA + confirm the scan scope is acceptable. Ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
Marco (Security): FYI — if Helix asks for penetration test artifacts (raw reports), we should avoid sharing full reports; provide executive summary + remediation status. Put that in the readme.
Anya (AE): Noted. Thanks all.
